english.note: Pick this for accepting or welcoming a person, thing, idea, or proposal, especially when emphasizing favorable reception.
Use this for the act of accepting or admitting someone or something into a group or arrangement.

examples.english: This new proposal got quick acceptance from the school.
examples.traditional: 學校好快就接納咗呢個新方案。

examples.english: The club will offer admission to ten more new members this year.
examples.traditional: 個會今年會接納多十個新會員。
